title: Step 4a: Predicting Salaries - Linear Regression in Python (Array Input Guide)

cues.en: Instructor: All right, here we go for that final step predicting the salary of the position level 6.5 with both linear regression and polynomial regression.
cues.zh: 好，進入最後一步，用線性迴歸與多項式迴歸，預測職位等級 6.5 的薪資。

cues.en: So we are gonna start with linear regression first therefore creating a new coattail here.
cues.zh: 先從線性迴歸開始，因此在這裡新增程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: Let's do it step by step.
cues.zh: 我們一步一步來。

cues.en: Of course, the first step you had to do here was to take your linear regrettor object.
cues.zh: 首先當然是使用線性迴歸器物件。

cues.en: You know from the simple linear regression model.
cues.zh: 也就是簡單線性迴歸模型的那個物件。

cues.en: And this object was named Lin Reg, this one.
cues.zh: 它的名稱是 lin_reg，就是這個。

cues.en: And then very simply, from this object you're gonna call the predict method, to predict the salary of the position level, 6.5.
cues.zh: 接著很簡單，對這個物件呼叫 predict 方法，預測職位等級 6.5 的薪資。

cues.en: All right, so what exactly do you need to input here in this predict method to get such a predicted salary?
cues.zh: 那麼，predict 方法裡究竟要傳入什麼，才能得到這個預測薪資？

cues.en: Well, I'm sure some of you try to directly input 6.5 but unfortunately this is not that simple because, indeed you always have to input your observations
cues.zh: 相信有些人試著直接輸入 6.5，但很可惜沒有這麼簡單，因為一定要將觀測資料

cues.en: in an array, right?
cues.zh: 放在陣列中，對吧？

cues.en: That's what is specified here in the parameters.
cues.zh: 參數說明就是這麼寫的。

cues.en: The input of the brick method should be an array like or a sparse matrix.
cues.zh: predict 方法的輸入必須是類陣列資料，或稀疏矩陣。

cues.en: So an array like is, for example, a non by array or a simple array with double pair of square brackets.
cues.zh: 例如 NumPy 陣列，或使用兩層中括號的簡單陣列表示方式。

cues.en: Well, you know, I said it.
cues.zh: 我已經把答案說出來了。

cues.en: That's exactly how you need to input an array because generally in Python an array is built with pairs of square brackets.
cues.zh: 這正是輸入陣列的方式，因為 Python 通常會使用成對的中括號來表示這類資料。

cues.en: If you add just a single pair of square brackets here well that actually creates a list or you can also see it as a vector.
cues.zh: 如果只加上一對中括號，實際上建立的是串列，也可以把它視為向量。

cues.en: But in order to create an array, well, you know an array contains several dimensions, like two dimensions in our case here, and therefore you need to add a double pair of square brackets.
cues.zh: 但要輸入這裡所需的陣列形式，因為陣列有多個維度，本例是二維，所以必須加上兩層中括號。

cues.en: What does this double pair of square brackets mean?
cues.zh: 這兩層中括號代表什麼？

cues.en: Well, the first pair of square brackets here corresponds to the first dimension, and the second pair of square brackets here corresponds to the second dimension.
cues.zh: 第一層中括號對應第一個維度，第二層中括號對應第二個維度。

cues.en: So the first dimension is actually corresponding to the rows in your array, and the second dimension is corresponding to your column.
cues.zh: 第一個維度實際上對應陣列的列，第二個維度對應欄。

cues.en: So for example, if I add, just to show you, if I add for example, five here, that would create actually an array of one row and two columns.
cues.zh: 例如示範一下，如果在這裡再加上 5，就會建立一個 1 列 2 欄的資料陣列。

cues.en: And if I add here a comma, and then another pair of square brackets, and then for example two and three.
cues.zh: 如果再加上逗號、另一對中括號，並在裡面輸入 2 和 3，

cues.en: Well, this would create indeed an array of two rows and two columns.
cues.zh: 就會建立 2 列 2 欄的陣列。

cues.en: In the first row, you would have 6.5 and five, and in the second row you would have two and three.
cues.zh: 第一列是 6.5 和 5，第二列是 2 和 3。

cues.en: So you see the first square bracket here corresponds to the rows, and the second one corresponds to the columns.
cues.zh: 所以第一層中括號對應列，第二層對應欄。

cues.en: All right, so let's go back to where we were exactly this.
cues.zh: 好，回到原本的內容，就是這樣。

cues.en: So this indeed is exactly the format expected by this break method, an array of two dimensions.
cues.zh: 這正是 predict 方法所預期的格式：二維陣列。

cues.en: Even if this only contains one sale, you know one value.
cues.zh: 即使裡面只有一個儲存格，也就是一個數值，

cues.en: Well, it has to be in this format.
cues.zh: 仍然必須採用這個格式。

cues.en: And now while you're ready to get that prediction, So before we execute this, let's remember that this person asked for a 160K salary
cues.zh: 現在可以取得預測了。執行之前，先記得這個人要求的薪資是 16 萬，

cues.en: and this is justified by the fact that this person earned a 160K salary in the previous company which is what we have to check right now.
cues.zh: 理由是他在上一家公司就領 16 萬，而這正是我們現在要核實的事。

cues.en: And we're gonna check that first with the linear regression model which returns indeed a salary of 330,000 dollars per year.
cues.zh: 先用線性迴歸模型來檢查，結果回傳的薪資是每年 33 萬美元。

cues.en: So if we actually use this model to negotiate with that person we would actually find it super weird, right?
cues.zh: 如果真的使用這個模型和對方談薪資，就會覺得非常奇怪，對吧？

cues.en: Because this predicted salary is way over the real salary that this person had in its previous company.
cues.zh: 因為這個預測薪資，遠高於對方在上一家公司實際領的薪資。

cues.en: So clearly the prediction here is wrong.
cues.zh: 所以這裡的預測顯然不對。

cues.en: And you know, that's what we can clearly see on the graph.
cues.zh: 這一點也能從圖上清楚看到。

cues.en: You know, the graph above showing the results of the linear regression model.
cues.zh: 就是上方顯示線性迴歸模型結果的圖。

cues.en: 6.5 is somewhere around here And indeed, if we want to get prediction we have to project it to that blue regression line and then project it again
cues.zh: 6.5 大約在這裡。要取得預測值，就將它投影到藍色迴歸直線，再投影

cues.en: to the vertical axis, which is around here.
cues.zh: 到縱軸，大約在這個位置。

cues.en: And indeed, that's what we get.
cues.zh: 這確實就是我們得到的結果。

cues.en: You know, this is multiplied by 10 at the bar of six.
cues.zh: 這裡的刻度要乘以 10 的 6 次方。

cues.en: So indeed, we get something around 330.
cues.zh: 所以得到的薪資大約是 33 萬。
